transformation: A LoRA (rank 16, all 24 layers) trained by the team on the game's own dialogue (晴雯, 老周, 灵光 and the other contacts, Chinese) is merged into the weights; the MTP (nextn) block is stripped (Tools/LocalLLM/strip_qwen_mtp.py); quantized with llama-quantize --imatrix --token-embedding-type q5_K ... Q5_K_S (Tools/LocalLLM/quantize_qwen35_2b.sh). Pipeline: Exports/model-work/lora.
usage: Local text generation only; no vision projector is bundled. Game slot context remains 4096.
replaces: Qwen3-1.7B-Q4_K_M.gguf (2026.10.20.x) and Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf (through 2026.10.19.5); historical packages remain unchanged.
reproducibility: Exact release bytes are pinned by Git LFS OID and SHA256SUMS.txt. LoRA adapter, training data/config revision, merge pipeline and report are not present in this repository; base, imatrix and quantizer tool revisions are not recorded. The candidate quantization script requires externally supplied original LoRA-merged bf16, imatrix and matching tools and does not reproduce the release from the public base alone.
